definitions.short: bright red (as piercing to the sight), i.e. bay
definitions.full: H8320. saroq I. [ שָׂרֹק ] adjective perhaps sorrel (? from II. ׳שׂ , or compare having ruddy tinge over white, of horses sorrel Lane 1581 ); — plural וּלְבָנִים שְׂרֻקִּים אֲדֻמִּים Zech 1:8 . of horses.

occurrences.englishText: “I had a vision in the night, and behold,† “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.
